svg.title: #3 0 MARIETTA RD NW, Atlanta (18.4 ac tax roll)
svg.text: HYPOTHETICAL: no road frontage. #3 0 MARIETTA RD NW,
rear-load 230 deep, court only, cars at office end (market depth,
Trailer stalls 21 (court rows 0, drop yard 21) vs target 21
Site 20.5 ac (county map) 10,300 SF/gross ac FAR 0.24
Access: no truck driveway; no road; frontage 0 ft
Graded area: relief ~51 ft, balanced cut/fill ~67,000 CY, steep
!! ACCESS_NONE: no public road frontage from the GDOT check:
landlocked or access by easement only; the plan is hypothetical
and its floor area is not counted
! ATL_PARKING_CODE: parking at the market ratio; Atlanta's 1/600
SF code minimum (unverified after the parking reforms) would need
! GRADING_RISK: 14% of the graded area is steeper than 15% (lidar)
! RELIEF: about 51 ft of relief across the graded area: terraces
! ZONING_DRAFT: setbacks and buffers are draft screening values
for atlanta; zoning_rules.json is the authority
! STREAMS_PIPELINES: stream lines and petroleum pipelines are not
mapped; mapped water, wetlands and floodplain get a 25 ft buffer
i BELOW_COMP_BAND: 10,327 SF per gross acre; Georgia comps run
i POND_SITE_FROM_LIDAR: pond placed low, near the module and on
its side of mapped wetlands; no outfall, maintenance drive or
paving envelope (draft setbacks/buffers, 25 ft from water)
Screening test fit from public data: not a survey, civil design or zoning
determination. Zoning values are draft; detention is a +/-30% estimate;
routes, fire access and grading are indicative.
